newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria says sugar tenders unlikely until end-year.
newsitem.headline: Syria says sugar tenders unlikely until end-year.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) said on Tuesday it expects to issue no more sugar tenders until the end of the year, a GEZA official said.
"It is unlikely that we will go to the market at this period as the holiday season is coming and it would be difficult to contact dealers until the end of the year," he said.
The official said GEZA was not planning any sugar tender for Wednesday.
This followed market talk earlier on Tuesday that Syria could soon be in the market after a bid for 13,000 tonnes of whites was cancelled at a tender last.
Last week GEZA bought 13,000 tonnes of raw sugar at $292.75 a tonne for delivery between December 20 and January 20.
